title: AI Medical Interpretation for Eye Care
summary: See how AI medical interpretation improves eye exams, drop schedules, and surgical consent accuracy for LEP patients this October 2026.
body_markdown:
###


Opalite Health supports 150+ languages and dialects through real-time AI medical interpretation, compared with roughly 45 for NoBarrier and approximately 35+ for Lexi, making it one of the broadest AI-native options for eye care teams serving multilingual patient populations. Run a live pilot with your top five community languages and verify laterality confirmation, numeric read-backs for intraocular pressure and refraction values, and drop schedule accuracy before committing.


###


Start pre-visit by capturing language, dialect, and format needs, then queue your interpreter before the patient arrives. Run real-time interpretation through history, acuity testing, intraocular pressure, drop counseling, and consent, then close with teach-back and a translated after-visit summary that mirrors the verbal instructions line by line.


###


Opalite Health with teach-back, numeric confirmation, and quality checks is a sound first-line path for surgical consent discussions; escalate to a qualified human interpreter from LanguageLine, Voiance, or Propio when confidence flags appear or the patient requests one. Document clarifications, confirm the operative eye in the patient's language, and provide a translated consent form aligned with the interpreted discussion.


###


Open outbound UDP ports 3478 and 50000-60000 for WebRTC audio in the web app, and confirm your firewall permits Opalite traffic during your security review. Keep a phone-based interpretation workflow as backup for Wi-Fi disruptions, position microphones 6 to 12 inches from speakers, and use push-to-talk mode in noisy rooms near slit lamps or fans.


###


Speak in 5-to-10-second chunks, one idea per segment, and confirm the eye, pressure value, medication name, and any negation aloud after each statement. If an output seems uncertain, pause, restate the phrase, and verify before moving forward; switch dialect or escalate to a qualified human interpreter if the mismatch is not resolved within the session.
